svg.title: THE RIG mark v0.3 — marionette controller (V1 refined + C2 color)
svg.desc: THE RIG mark v0.3 lock 2026-05-12. Marionette controller silhouette: T-handle (top bar + stem + crossbar) at top · 3 strings descending with deliberate low-tension catenary at asymmetric lengths (LEFT medium · CENTER longest · RIGHT shortest · per rule) · 3 triangle weight anchors. Color treatment C2: structure in Navy #0f172a · CENTER string in Steel #64748b (the operator's primary path · the work flowing) · CENTER anchor in Oxblood #7c2d12 (the asset · value landing). Rigid+flow duality enacted in color: rigid frame Navy · fluid flow Steel · asset value Oxblood.
